people.note: `sensitivity: sensitive` only when the person's role or status is itself the protected fact (an unannounced hire, a departure not yet public). A sensitive claim about someone does not make their record sensitive. scripts/build_dashboards.py reads this field. `aliases` is load-bearing: the connector renders one name up to four ways.

topics.note: A view over claims, not a source of truth. Anything asserted here exists as a claim with its own citation, or corp-os-reality-check cannot see it and it rots unnoticed.

glossary.note: Jargon, product terms, acronyms, role names, and metric definitions. Metric definitions are the half that matters.

dashboards.note: Regenerable. A dashboard is never a source of truth.

confidence_ceilings.raw_marker: reconstructed: true in frontmatter, or a 0000-00-00-- filename prefix
confidence_ceilings.note: Original source text no longer exists. Citation is the literal `no source`. Cannot reach confirmed without new material.

confidence_ceilings.raw_marker: granola_id in frontmatter; body opens '> Source: Granola AI meeting summary. Not a verbatim transcript.'
confidence_ceilings.note: Summaries, not verbatim, so one cannot satisfy the Citation requirement. Reaches confirmed via get_meeting_transcript on the Granola connector — cheap, per claim, worth it for one that gates a decision.

placement_instructions.instruction: The personal departure account lives in sensitive.md only. That record carries none of it and NO pointer or 'context exists elsewhere' note — the breadcrumb is the signal being avoided. The operational fact of the departure and the coverage it triggered is separate, load-bearing, and lives in the scan path as claims.
placement_instructions.outranks: the bearing rule and the entry schema, even if a later pass judges the material load_bearing
placement_instructions.note: TODO: nothing in the plugin reads this array. The mechanism corp-os-rebuild actually honours is `placement: sensitive` in the frontmatter of the raw file(s) holding this material. Add it there; keep this as the human-readable copy.

product-brain.note: Claim IDs are stable across the boundary. `sensitive` never crosses; `sensitive` + `load_bearing` crosses as a redacted stub carrying id, kind, jobs and decay but not body, so the far side knows a fact is withheld rather than computing without it.
